accepted_facts.claim: lib/osv3/foundation/** is the frozen OS23.7 seed; import from it, never modify it
existing OS23.6 behavior must remain unchanged when new OS v3 features are unused
Taste is first-class and separate from identity; identity-role references are rejected
legacy provenance stays honestly partial; never invent biometrics or provider/model provenance

hard_constraints: no GitHub push / PR / remote mutation
no secrets, .env, provider keys in commits or artifacts
no out-of-scope tracked writes (WRITE_SET enforced by trusted ingestor)
no provider billing or live paid generation
no merge commits on the worker branch
no edits to lib/osv3/foundation/** (frozen construction seed)
no dependency on unpublished same-wave peer output
forward fixes only; do not rewrite history to hide mistakes
issuer: osv3ctl trusted local plane / ZCode Desktop

output_contract.git_delta: <RUN_ID>-run.bundle with named ref refs/heads/w001/<RUN_ID> and exact INPUT_SHA prerequisite
